suggestions.title: The Social Network
suggestions.description: In 2003, Harvard undergrad Mark Zuckerberg hacks a campus gossip site into what will become Facebook — and a friendship turns into a legal war. David Fincher's razor-sharp origin story, scripted by Aaron Sorkin, crackles with wit, ambition, and betrayal. The definitive film about the cost of building the future: endlessly quotable, brilliantly paced, and anchored by Jesse Eisenberg's magnetic lead performance.

suggestions.title: Get Out
suggestions.description: When Chris (Daniel Kaluuya) meets his white girlfriend's family for the first time, the weekend getaway takes a deeply unsettling turn. Jordan Peele's modern horror landmark is a brilliant, layered social thriller — funny, terrifying, and razor-smart in equal measure. A genre masterpiece that rewired what a horror movie can say, and the debut that announced a major new voice.

suggestions.title: Good Bye Lenin!
suggestions.description: East Berlin, 1989: when Alex's devoted socialist mother wakes from a coma months after the Wall has fallen, he rebuilds a fake GDR around her to protect her fragile health — one elaborate lie at a time. Wolfgang Becker's tender, hilarious, and heartbreaking German classic captures the chaos of reunification with enormous heart and a wry smile. Perfect for fans of the German cinema streak in your collection.
